variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.body: The home world has sent a punitive expedition. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: An expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.body: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.body: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
